sections.heading: Vietnam’s Support for Laos’s Digital Identity
China’s Aviation Training and Border Exchanges
What the Projects Reveal—and What They Don’t

central_finding.quote: The available record establishes more about the capabilities being developed than about who will ultimately control their use.

establishes.quote: The reported issuance figure is Vietnam’s, not an independently audited count; nonetheless, the handover concerns an administrative system and actual documented usage, rather than only a promise of future cooperation.

uncertain.quote: Both China and Laos operate K-8s; photographs of parked aircraft do not establish their ownership, the presence of a permanent Chinese garrison, exclusive basing rights, or an operational combat mission.
